title: Jharkhand JSSC Excise Constable 2023 Result
vacancyDetails: 583 Excise Constable posts under JECCE-2023; Combined Merit List released with marks and selection status
qualification: Matric (10th) pass from a recognized board as per JSSC JECCE-2023 notification
ageLimit: 18 to 25 years as on 01 Aug 2023 (relaxations as per Jharkhand Govt rules)
selectionProcess: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) → Written Examination → Combined Merit List → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Registration/roll number for merit PDF search; educational certificates, category certificate, domicile, photo ID for DV
howToApply:
1. Visit https://jssc.jharkhand.gov.in
2. Open Combined Merit List – JECCE-2023 notice
3. Download result PDF
4. Search Registration / Roll Number
5. Note selection status and follow further instructions
shortDescription: JSSC JECCE-2023 Excise Constable Result 2026 out on 28 July 2026 for 583 posts. Written exam on 12 April 2026. Download Combined Merit List at jssc.jharkhand.gov.in.
content:
The Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has released the JECCE-2023 Combined Merit List for Excise Constable recruitment covering 583 posts.

Result was published on 28 July 2026. The written examination was held on 12 April 2026 after PET stages conducted earlier (PET admit cards from Aug 2024 cycle as scheduled).

Merit list includes

  • Registration number and roll number
  • Paper-wise marks and total percentage
  • Eligibility / reserved category and final selection status

There is no separate individual scorecard in many cases—candidates must search their details in the official Combined Merit List PDF on jssc.jharkhand.gov.in.
